corrections.reason: Both the printed glyph in Column 1 Line 26 and Classical Ge'ez grammar (accusative numeral modifying 'ኅብስተ') confirm 1st-order 'ዐ' ('ሰብዐ'), not 2nd-order 'ዑ'.
In the image, Line 5 ends with just 'እ-' and wraps onto Line 6 ('ንዳየ'); Stage 1 erroneously completed the word at the end of Line 5, creating a duplicate 'እንዳየንዳየ' in the rejoined stream.
Visual inspection of Column 3 Line 26 shows 1st-order 'ደ' ('፩ደ', accusative 'አሐደ እምነቢያት' governed by 'ይብሉኒ' / 'ወይቤልዎ', translated in Line 27 as 'አንዱን') without a 2nd-order right-side stroke.
